s1.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular compromise
key_facts: 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
invasion of the superior vena cava
thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
symptomatic relief with heparin and corticosteroids
multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells

raw.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular compromise
key_facts: 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
invasion of the superior vena cava
thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
symptomatic relief with heparin and corticosteroids
multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: WT1 positivity and CD99 positivity are characteristic of this tumor

shortlist.label: Ewing's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD99 positivity is a hallmark of Ewing's sarcoma, and the patient's age and symptoms are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with a primitive neuroectodermal tumor, and CD99 positivity is often seen in this tumor

shortlist.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including the large mediastinal mass and vascular invasion, are consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Thymoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including the anterior superior mediastinal mass, are consistent with thymoma

raw.rationale: The patient's histopathology showing a multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm and immunohistochemistry demonstrating diffuse strong WT1 positivity and moderate, patchy CD99 positivity are characteristic of Desmoplastic small round cell tumor

rejected.label: Ewing's sarcoma
rejected.why: While Ewing's sarcoma can also show CD99 positivity, the combination of WT1 positivity and the specific histopathological features points more towards Desmoplastic small round cell tumor

rejected.label: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely due to the lack of specific neuroectodermal markers and the presence of WT1 positivity

rejected.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The histopathology and immunohistochemistry do not support a lymphoma diagnosis

rejected.label: Thymoma
rejected.why: Thymomas typically have a different histological appearance and do not usually express WT1 or CD99 in this pattern
